title: Hotspots over the full record
definition: One row per hotspot: its label, events, places, peak intensity, centre, days active, stability and its persistence and spike classification.
notes: Hotspots: 133 hotspots; persistent and spike classes are not valid on this input (they need 30 days of history before the period). Largest: Tehran 2,674 events; Gaza City 2,488 events; Jerusalem 2,315 events; Tel Aviv 1,910 events; ‘Aramsha 1,091 events.
